bracketing-plan.name: Auto Exposure Bracketing (AEB) Plan Calculator
bracketing-plan.intro: Plan an exposure bracketing sequence: choose the number of frames and EV step to cover the scene dynamic range, and get the shutter speed for each frame.

calc-exposure-aperture.name: Exposure Triangle Calculator (Aperture, Shutter, ISO)
calc-exposure-aperture.intro: Balance the exposure triangle by adjusting aperture, shutter speed and ISO, and see how many stops each change shifts the exposure.

capacity-fps.name: Video Frame Rate, Duration and Storage Calculator
capacity-fps.intro: Estimate recording duration or required storage from frame rate, resolution, bitrate and clip length.

card-capacity.name: Memory Card Shot Capacity Estimator
card-capacity.intro: Estimate how many photos a memory card can hold from card capacity, image resolution and file format.

convert-focal.name: Lens Focal Length and Angle of View Converter
convert-focal.intro: Convert focal length to angle of view for a given sensor size, and compare how the field of view changes across formats.

depth-of-field.name: Depth of Field (DOF) Calculator
depth-of-field.intro: Calculate depth of field from focal length, aperture, focus distance and sensor size, giving near and far limits and hyperfocal distance.

dpi.name: Print Resolution (DPI) Calculator
dpi.intro: Compute print resolution in DPI from pixel dimensions and print size, or find the maximum print size at a target DPI.

dynamic-range.name: Dynamic Range Stops Calculator
dynamic-range.intro: Estimate the dynamic range in stops from highlight and shadow limits, and check whether the scene fits the sensor's latitude.

equivalent-focal.name: Equivalent Focal Length Converter
equivalent-focal.intro: Convert a lens focal length between sensor formats using the crop factor to get the equivalent full-frame focal length.

ev.name: Exposure Value (EV) Reference
ev.intro: Reference common exposure values (EV) for typical lighting scenes and map them to aperture, shutter speed and ISO combinations.

exposure-value.name: Exposure Value (EV) Calculator
exposure-value.intro: Calculate the exposure value from aperture and shutter speed, and find equivalent EV combinations for the same brightness.

field-of-view.name: Field of View (FOV) Calculator
field-of-view.intro: Calculate horizontal, vertical and diagonal field of view from focal length and sensor dimensions.

flash-gn.name: Flash Guide Number (GN) Calculator
flash-gn.intro: Calculate flash guide number, working distance or required aperture from any two of the three values, accounting for ISO and zoom.

golden-hour.name: Daylight Duration and Golden Hour Estimator
golden-hour.intro: Estimate daylight duration and the golden hour windows for a given date and location to plan outdoor shoots.

hyperfocal.name: Hyperfocal Distance Calculator
hyperfocal.intro: Compute the hyperfocal distance from focal length, aperture and circle of confusion to maximise sharpness from near to infinity.

macro-magnification.name: Macro Magnification Calculator
macro-magnification.intro: Calculate magnification ratio from focal length and extension tube length, and see the resulting field of view and exposure loss.

mired.name: Mired Color Temperature Converter
mired.intro: Convert between colour temperature (Kelvin) and mired values, and estimate the colour correction filter needed between two light sources.

nd-filter.name: ND Filter Shutter Speed Calculator
nd-filter.intro: Calculate the new shutter speed when adding an ND filter of a given stop value, useful for long-exposure photography.

photo-10.name: Bracketing Frame Count Calculator
photo-10.intro: Find the number of bracketing frames needed to cover a given EV range at a chosen exposure step.

photo-11.name: Panning Shutter Speed Calculator
photo-11.intro: Estimate a suitable panning shutter speed from subject speed, direction and focal length to keep the subject sharp with directional blur.

photo-2.name: Equivalent Focal Length Calculator
photo-2.intro: Convert focal length between full-frame and crop sensors to compare the effective angle of view of different lenses.

photo-3.name: Flash Guide Number Calculator
photo-3.intro: Compute flash guide number from distance and aperture, or derive the correct aperture for a given flash-to-subject distance.

photo-4.name: Star Trail Exposure Time Calculator
photo-4.intro: Calculate star trail exposure time from focal length and sensor crop factor to control the length of star trails.

photo-5.name: Focus Hyperfocal Distance Calculator
photo-5.intro: Calculate the hyperfocal distance and the range of acceptable sharpness for landscape focusing at a given aperture.

photo-6.name: Angle of View Calculator
photo-6.intro: Calculate the angle of view from focal length and sensor size to visualise how much of the scene a lens captures.

photo-7.name: Magnification Ratio Calculator
photo-7.intro: Calculate the magnification ratio of a close-up setup from focal length, extension and minimum focus distance.

photo-8.name: Image File Size Estimator
photo-8.intro: Estimate image file size from resolution, bit depth and compression ratio before shooting or exporting.

photo-9.name: Diffraction Limit Aperture Calculator
photo-9.intro: Estimate the aperture at which diffraction begins to limit resolution for a given sensor pixel pitch.

photo.name: Depth of Field Calculator
photo.intro: Calculate depth of field, near and far focus limits and hyperfocal distance from focal length, aperture, distance and sensor size.

print-size.name: Pixel to Print Size Reference
print-size.intro: Reference how pixel dimensions map to physical print sizes at common resolutions such as 300 and 150 DPI.

raw-size.name: RAW File Size Estimator
raw-size.intro: Estimate RAW file size from sensor resolution and bit depth, with typical compression ratios for common camera formats.

safe-shutter.name: Safe Shutter Speed Calculator
safe-shutter.intro: Find the slowest safe handheld shutter speed from focal length and crop factor, with stops of stabilisation taken into account.
